In this video, we want to introduce ourselves and present the concept of our project — THE WASTE, a fast-paced criminal shooter where every firefight is pure stress, thrill, and an adrenaline rush.

notes.title: What is THE WASTE?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/93920c2b44e38381d26554c24af595956d3f1d08.gif[/img]

What is THE WASTE?
Welcome to THE WASTE – a brutal and stylish action game about survival in a world where laws no longer matter. Nova-City has collapsed under the weight of chaos, and now the streets belong to those strong enough to survive.
Today, we’ll tell you what awaits you in this world and why THE WASTE is more than just a shooter.

🏙 A World Without Rules
Nova-City was once a metropolis of the future: neon skyscrapers, a thriving economy, and advanced technology. But everything changed. Political crisis, economic collapse, and rampant crime turned the city into a battleground.
Now, two powerful factions fight for control over the city, its resources, and the survivors. Ordinary people have only one choice – pick a side or perish.
👉 Live by your own rules – join the fight for power or survive as a lone wolf. In this world, there are no heroes, only predators and prey.
🔫 No-Compromise Gameplay
THE WASTE is a hardcore action game where every battle requires skill, tactics, and quick reflexes.
🔥 Realistic combat system – feel every bullet, every recoil, every shot.
🎯 Intense firefights – mistakes are unforgiving, demanding precision and strategy.
⚡ Fast-paced, dynamic gameplay – your decisions matter as much as your firepower.
🌆 Explore Dangerous Districts
Nova-City is a city where every street can be a deadly trap or a source of valuable resources.
🚧 Slums and ghettos – ruled by street gangs and illegal trade.
🏢 Economic zone – hiding secrets of the past and deadly threats.
🌉 Abandoned industrial areas – dangerous but full of opportunities for survivors.
There are no safe zones here. No second chances. Every step outside is a risk.
🛠 Progression, Gear, and Freedom of Choice
Forge your own path:
💰 Earn money – complete contracts, trade goods.
🔧 Upgrade your gear – find rare items and enhance your arsenal.
⚖ Choose your strategy – play solo or build your own team.
In THE WASTE, there is no fixed storyline – you write your own story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/92e356aaba4c91152868145fe4f62da5db75187e.gif[/img]

🔜 What’s Next?
🔥 Development is in full swing, and in the coming months, we’ll reveal more gameplay footage, characters, and mechanics.
💬 Want to stay updated?
Add the game to your wishlist and follow our updates – more action is coming soon!

notes.title: Devlog #0: Hello World!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey there, this is THE WASTE development team![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/5778b0fdd38a83dcb29786ba808c892534f4737f.jpg[/img]

In this update, we want to tell you a little about ourselves, but much more about the game.
We're a small team of just a few people, but we have a burning desire to create something that has never been done before. What will come of it? Time will tell. But for now, let’s talk about the goals of the game, what it is, and why you should definitely play it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/56f79c6e4687fd3722f3225326e7670bd7e51b00.jpg[/img]

THE WASTE is a game mode where you can either team up with others or go solo if you're, let’s say, a sigma... or a p***y? Doesn't matter. If you're a team player, great—you'll enjoy the cooperation. If you prefer to go at it alone, that’s just as valid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/2628b182e366c32b6d8e155d1ff28ad726358f05.png[/img]

Our focus is on immersion and character control. We’ve made the conscious decision not to force players into endless menus, spending hours tweaking weapon attachments. Yes, we have upgrades, but only the essentials—optics, laser sights, suppressors, and the like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/47ab5defa06db053e6e9882ad644ce398f5d727c.jpg[/img]

Honestly, one of the biggest problems with modern games is that players spend too much time in the interface instead of actually playing. More often than not, this is done deliberately to keep players engaged long enough to avoid refunds.

[b]Feel like a real person.[/b]

Even in the alpha build, you'll notice it. The gunplay is alive, heads fly off, enemies scream in pain, and if you start a fight in a narrow alley, things can turn into a bloody massacre real quick. But if you're into tactical gameplay, there's room for that too. It all depends on your approach.

[b]So, what is THE WASTE all about?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457961/81bc57d1c3ad0aa4832ec4c1088d9bb66bcb4695.jpg[/img]

It’s about life itself. Blood, concrete, and crime. A never-ending cycle of money, power, and bodies piling up. And all of it backed by brutal street shootouts. What could be better than an old-school street firefight? (In a game, of course.) We believe nothing gets the adrenaline pumping like that.
Friends, follow us, support us with a like and a share. Join our community. If you have ideas, we’re always open to hearing something new!

[b]Good luck to everyone![/b]
